decision_instructions: Which action does the support policy call for on this ticket? Rule 4 applies to every refund the policy gives, including the out-of-stock refund in rule 3 for a lost or undelivered order: if the matching rule says refund and the order total is over $500, choose escalate. The $500 limit changes only refunds; when the matching rule says reship or reply, choose that at any order total.

criteria.0: refund: refund the order, only when the order total is $500 or less
criteria.2: escalate: hand the ticket to a supervisor, including any case where the policy gives a refund and the order total is over $500
criteria.3: reply: reply to the customer and take no other action
